items.text: Retail management careers run from store operations and visual merchandising to category management, supply planning and e-commerce operations, and they reward people who can read daily sales, manage a team on their feet and keep stock, service and cost in balance.
Start in a store or a fulfilment role, learn how sales, stock and staffing connect, then move toward area, category or planning roles.
Ask for written terms before accepting a role.
